At Opus, every detail is considered. Our intimate tasting menu experience is guided by seasonality, precision, and a deep respect for exceptional ingredients. Choose between a thoughtfully composed 5-course or 7-course tasting menu, where each course is carefully paced to create a seamless progression of flavor, texture, and technique.\\

\\
With limited seating and attentive, personalized service, Opus offers an immersive dining experience where culinary craftsmanship and hospitality take precedence. Every evening is designed to be unhurried, memorable, and quietly exceptional.\\

Van Acre, A Wausau Experience.\\

A community with deep roots and a story to tell, Wausau is the kind of place to discover and make your own. This goes for anyone who wanders these parts from near or far. Whether you’re from here or took a road that led here. Whether you’re here for the moment or for a lifetime. Van Acre is a restaurant and bar that echoes this spirit. \\
\\
Located within the one of a kind Hilton Garden Inn Wausau, our heart for homegrown hospitality comes to life with authentic food and drink, a captivating space and passionate team. Our menu is inspired by the region with seasonal rustic fare served alongside classic and creative cocktails, craft brews and a curated wine list.\\
\\
No matter what your journey, we invite you to savor all that is put on your table and enjoy each other’s company along the way.\\

Discover Generations Bistro & Marketplace, a cozy European‑inspired spot just minutes from Lambeau Field and downtown Green Bay. Led by Chef Lukas Lipburger, our menu blends Central European traditions with international flair, featuring country‑inspired dishes that rotate monthly, our signature dish—Austrian Wiener Schnitzel — and our Grass-Fed Gourmet Burgers. \\
\\
A Diners’ Choice 2025 winner, we offer a relaxed, family‑friendly atmosphere perfect for brunch, date nights, and large gatherings, plus a cozy garden-inspired backyard patio. We specialize in dietary accommodations—90% of our menu can be made gluten‑free or dairy‑free, with abundant vegetarian options. \\
\\
Explore our Marketplace with organic groceries, wine, spirits, zero‑proof & THC selections, and clean specialty items. Enjoy organic Julius Meinl coffee, cold‑pressed Italian sodas, smoothies, and farm‑to‑table dishes crafted with local ingredients. Generations celebrates wholesome food, community, and European charm.](https://www.opentable.com/r/generations-bistro-and-marketplace-green-bay)

### Discover Wisconsin

Do you think skiing and Wisconsin go together? Now you can add food to that list! Due to a historically large Germanic population, you will find many heartwarming meals here. Hamburgers are loved in America, and Wisconsin took that to heart. Take some crafted, in-state cheese, add butter with the hamburger, and wrap with a bun. If you find yourself on the road, there are many varieties of Wisconsin sausage. You'll get hungry just thinking about the fresh cranberries, the official fruit of Wisconsin, and all the decadent desserts that include them. The discovery of lead brought miners from England that imparted their love of pasties, which is actually closer to a pot pie. While looking like an omelet, you’ll find an assortment of potatoes, rutabaga, onions, and meat inside Cornish pasties.

### Frequently asked questions

#### Which restaurants in Wisconsin are dog friendly?

Dog friendly restaurants in Wisconsin include [Lucille](https://www.opentable.com/r/lucille-madison), [Everly](https://www.opentable.com/r/everly-madison-2) and [Harbor Fish Market & Grille](https://www.opentable.com/r/harbor-fish-market-and-grille-baileys-harbor)

#### Which restaurants in Wisconsin are child friendly?

Child friendly restaurants in Wisconsin include [Nicks On The Lake @ Popeyes On Lake Geneva](https://www.opentable.com/r/popeyes-on-lake-geneva), [Cooper's Hawk Winery & Restaurant - Pleasant Prairie, WI](https://www.opentable.com/r/coopers-hawk-winery-and-restaurant-pleasant-prairie-wi-pleasant-prairie) and [Harbor Fish Market & Grille](https://www.opentable.com/r/harbor-fish-market-and-grille-baileys-harbor)
